title: LogicTree-RAG: Logic Tree-guided Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Long-form Patent Drafting
abstract: arXiv:2609.30943v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Long-form technical text generation underpins knowledge-intensive workflows, yet remains challenging for large language models (LLMs) due to the need for globally consistent logical structuring and faithful technical reasoning beyond local coherence. Patent drafting is a canonical instance of this challenge, demanding holistic generation of a legally compliant and technically exhaustive document through sustained multi-expert collaboration. Existing approaches often focus on partial section generation or rely on manually crafted outlines, limiting scalable automation in realistic settings. In this work, we propose LogicTree-RAG, a logic tree-guided retrieval-augmented generation framework that induces a hierarchical logic tree as a global organizational backbone to organize and ground technical disclosures, without relying on expert-defined drafting priors. tldr: 提出LogicTree-RAG框架，通过构建层次化逻辑树作为全局组织主干来引导检索增强生成，在不依赖专家先验知识的情况下实现长篇专利文档的整体自动化撰写。
en_tdlr: LogicTree-RAG induces a hierarchical logic tree as a global organizational backbone to guide retrieval-augmented generation, enabling holistic automated drafting of long-form patent documents without relying on expert-defined priors.
